title.narrative: Engendering CAFOD Partner Organisations for Sustainable Development

description.narrative:
Gender gaps in institutions and structures in Nigeria have remained huge developmental challenges for the country. In every sector of the economy women and girl-children suffer marginalization qualitatively and quantitatively in accessing basic resources and observance of their human rights. There have been various efforts to address these anomalies but more need to be done.
In line with addressing these gaps there is need for an organisation like the Catholic Agency for Overseas Development (CAFOD) who has a vision to see a world where the rights and dignity of every person (male and female) is respected and where all have access to basic needs of life among others to understand the gender gaps that exist within its organisation and partners organisations to enable it have a nuanced understanding of challenges faces by men and women as well as the boy-child and girl-child in her programmes areas and seek ways of addressing these challenges.
In addressing these gender disparities, CWSI will ?Conduct an Audit of CAFOD Nigeria and its Programme, ?Carry out an analysis of Partners programmes & Projects in Catholic Secretariat of Nigeria, Justice, Development and Peace Commission National, Catholic Caritas, JDPC-Abuja, Kontangora Vicariate as well as Idah, Lokoja and Ilorin Dioceses. ?Identify gaps in programmes and conduct capacity building training to address the gaps identified. ?Conduct awareness and sensitization on gender issues, targeting gate keepers, Church groups, government, civil society organisations, traditional institutions, and the media. ?Strengthen capacity of partner organisations to mainstream gender at organizational level and in project implementation. ?Strengthen capacity of partner organisations to deliver on the gender outcomes agreed on.
The understanding of basic gender concepts and their application is necessary to fully implement gender-focused projects. This intervention will expand the scope of employing appropriate advocacy tools.
Data made available will effect positive policy and attitudinal change and ensure appropriate gender mainstreaming in every aspect of development for CAFOD and its partners.
The project will be of benefit to CAFOD and her partners - Catholic Secretariat of Nigeria, Justice, Development and Peace Commission National, Catholic Caritas, JDPC-Abuja, Kontangora Vicariate as well as Idah, Lokoja and Ilorin Dioceses.
